newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha firm on Asia demand, trade play.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha firm on Asia demand, trade play.

text.p: NWE naphtha was firmer on Wednesday thanks to potential demand from Asia, despite lacklustre crude oil markets, traders said.
"At the close of business (in Asia,) arbitrage from Europe was not workable but I expect it to be stronger there in the morning," one trader at a major oil refining company said.
August swaps were pegged up at around $188 a tonne cif NWE. Dealers also said that trade plays had forced the price above levels that would be dictated by pure supply/demand.
"The prices are higher because certain people want it that way," one dealer said. "The fundamentals have not changed that much."
